User Story: As a Remote Patient, I want my registered device to send timestamped SpO2, heart-rate, and blood-pressure readings so that my caregiver can monitor me remotely.
As an On-Call Caregiver, I want to view current and recent patient vitals so that I can assess the patient's condition.
As an On-Call Caregiver, I want every valid reading evaluated against the patient's active clinical thresholds so that anomalies are detected consistently.
As an On-Call Caregiver, I want a threshold-breach alert to show the metric, value, threshold, patient, and time so that I can respond quickly.
As an assigned On-Call Caregiver, I want to receive an immediate notification for a critical alert so that I can begin a response.
As a member of the care team, I want an unacknowledged critical alert escalated through the caregiver matrix so that emergencies are not missed.
As an On-Call Caregiver, I want to acknowledge an alert and record an action or note so that the response is documented.
As an On-Call Caregiver, I want alert acknowledgements and notification attempts recorded with timestamps so that the event history is traceable.
